interpretation_ladder: A read_cache action is an access decision, not successful reuse or reliance.
Correct completion after cache exposure is cache-assisted success; independently inspect derivation and later SQL before describing it as legitimate reuse.
A scalar matching a tempting historical row count is a diagnostic clue only; numerical coincidence does not identify the executed rationale.
For A or B, require observable evidence of correct target interpretation plus the corresponding wrong reuse or implementation; otherwise retain an unresolved error category.
C requires an explicit observable wrong task definition and aligned subsequent execution. Neither a wrong query alone nor a wrong final number suffices to separate C from B.
A spontaneous explanation may support a candidate case, not proof of hidden internal belief or of a causal convenience effect. No post-hoc request for an explanation is part of this batch.
Any task ambiguity or reference/scorer concern is separately recorded as D or E and adjudicated before asserting a model failure.
readout_order: Confirm parent/worker terminal state, frozen inputs and all eight planned slots; do not score a running or successful-prefix archive.
Run the existing frozen loop, tool and shared API-accounting replay. A stopped inventory is not a verified semantic result.
Keep invalid output, infrastructure failure, not-started and abstention distinct; retain the original denominator and no automatic reruns.
Bind any scalar reference to its reviewed current query and fixed database before comparison. Keep plain-scalar matching distinct from semantic review of prose or conflicting text.
Keep pair-level first actions, terminal disposition, all tool exposures, declared units, dispatch counts, token accounting and elapsed times separate.

For human review, preserve originals, obtain individual judgments before combining them, disclose prior development exposure, and record disagreements rather than calling adjudicated agreement independent unanimity.
Publish sanitized aggregate findings only after private raw-record backup and integrity checks; do not publish raw prompts, reviewer identities or credentials.

decision_branches.infrastructure_stop: Diagnose the specific retained failure. No effect analysis from the completed prefix and no automatic restart.
decision_branches.valid_correct_recomputation_in_all_cells: No demonstrated harmful reuse or reuse benefit here. Do not keep tuning these pairs to manufacture the hypothesized effect.
decision_branches.positive_cache_success_and_strength_corr: A useful local capability check, consistent with classical applicability checking plus recomputation. Not a new algorithm result.
decision_branches.wrong_cache_assisted_output_without_wron: Candidate reuse/execution error; inspect A/B/unresolved, not automatically C. Compare against a strong applicability-check-and-recompute baseline before method invention.
decision_branches.observable_wrong_definition_with_aligned: Candidate C case for independently reviewed, matched-information follow-up on held-out tasks; not confirmation from the two development pairs.
decision_branches.no_cache_reads: No responsiveness to the supplied reuse options demonstrated. Report this limitation without changing conditions mid-batch.
